role: Harness GuiScreen shown while the world loads in place of the main menu; it does not pause the game, so the integrated server never runs its pause-save at join.
used_by: oracle/src/client/Minecraft.java displayGuiScreen hook (replaces the main menu)
notes: 24 lines; no native counterpart needed (client GUI only). In a pool JVM its first construction per run makes the GuiScreen initializer's seeder draw that a fresh JVM makes at that point (Pool.joinDrawn).
